verses.geez: ወልድየ፡ ዕቀብ፡ ነገረ፡ ዚአየ፡ ወትእዛዘ፡ ዚአየ፡ ይባእ፡ ኀቤከ።
verses.translation: My son, keep my words, and hide with thee my commandments.

translations.lxx: My son, honour the Lord, and thou shalt be strong; and fear none but him:
translations.kjv: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.
translations.ron: Fiul meu; păzeşte spusele mele şi îndrumările mele ascunde-le la tine.
translations.grk: Υἱὲ φύλασσε ἐμοὺς λόγους, τὰς δὲ ἐμὰς ἐντολὰς κρύψον παρὰ σεαυτῷ· Υἱὲ τίμα τὸν Κύριον καὶ ἰσχύσεις, πλὴν δὲ αὐτοῦ μὴ φοβοῦ ἄλλον·

verses.geez: ወልድየ፡ አክብሮ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ወትጸንዕ፡ እምኵሉ፡ ወዘእንበሌሁሰ፡ ኢትፍራህ፡ ባዕደ፡ እስመ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘይቀትለከ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘያሐይወከ።
verses.translation: keep my commandments, and thou shalt live; and keep my words as the pupils of thine eyes.

translations.lxx: keep my commandments, and thou shalt live; and keep my words as the pupils of thine eyes.
translations.kjv: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.
translations.ron: Păstrează sfaturile mele ca să rămâi în viaţă şi orânduielile mele ca lumina ochilor tăi.
translations.grk: φύλαξον ἐμὰς ἐντολὰς καὶ βιώσεις, τοὺς δὲ ἐμοὺς λόγους ὥσπερ κόρας ὀμμάτων.

verses.geez: ወልድየ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ ዚአየ፡ ዕቀብ፡ ወተሐዩ፡ ወንባበ፡ ዚአየ፡ ዕቀብ፡ ከመ፡ ብንተ፡ ዓይንከ።
verses.translation: And bind them on thy fingers, and write them on the table of thine heart.

translations.lxx: And bind them on thy fingers, and write them on the table of thine heart.
translations.kjv: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.
translations.ron: Leagă-le pe degetele tale, scrie-le pe tabla inimii tale!
translations.grk: Περίθου δὲ αὐτοὺς σοῖς δακτύλοις, ἐπίγραψον δὲ ἐπὶ τὸ πλάτος τῆς καρδίας σου.

verses.geez: ደዮ፡ ውስተ፡ አፃብዒከ፡ ወጸሐፎ፡ ውስተ፡ ራኅበ፡ ልብከ።
verses.translation: Say that wisdom is thy sister, and gain prudence as an acquaintance for thyself;

translations.lxx: Say that wisdom is thy sister, and gain prudence as an acquaintance for thyself;
translations.kjv: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman:
translations.ron: Spune înţelepciunii: "Tu eşti sora mea!", şi numeşte priceperea prietena ta,
translations.grk: Εἰπὸν τὴν σοφίαν σὴν ἀδελφὴν εἶναι, τὴν δὲ φρόνησιν γνώριμον περιποίησαι σεαυτῷ.

verses.geez: በላ፡ ለጥበብ፡ እኅተ፡ ዚአየ፡ አንቲ፡ ወለአእምሮ፡ ሀገሪተከ፡ ረስያ።
verses.translation: that she may keep thee from the strange and wicked woman, if she should assail thee with flattering words.

translations.lxx: that she may keep thee from the strange and wicked woman, if she should assail thee with flattering words.
translations.kjv: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words.
translations.ron: Ca ea să te păzească de femeia străină, de femeia altuia, ale cărei cuvinte sunt ademenitoare.
translations.grk: Ἵνα σε τηρήσῃ ἀπὸ γυναικὸς ἀλλοτρίας καὶ πονηρᾶς, ἐάν σε λόγοις τοῖς πρὸς χάριν ἐμβάληται.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ትዕቀብከ፡ እምብእሲት፡ ነኪርት፡ ወእኪት፡ ወእም፡ ነገረ፡ ዘርቅ፡ አምጽአት፡ ብከ።
verses.translation: For she looks from a window out of her house into the streets, at one whom she may see of the senseless ones, a young man void of understanding,

translations.lxx: For she looks from a window out of her house into the streets, at one whom she may see of the senseless ones, a young man void of understanding,
translations.kjv: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,
translations.ron: Odată stam la fereastra casei mele şi priveam printre gratii,
translations.grk: Ἀπὸ γὰρ θυρίδος ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου αὐτῆς εἰς τὰς πλατείας παρακύπτουσα,

verses.geez: እስመ፡ እመስኮተ፡ ቤታ፡ ውስተ፡ መራኅብት፡ ትሔውጽ።
verses.translation: passing by the corner in the passages near her house,

translations.lxx: passing by the corner in the passages near her house,
translations.kjv: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,
translations.ron: Şi am zărit printre cei lipsiţi de minte, am văzut un tânăr fără pricepere.
translations.grk: ὃν ἂν ἴδῃ τῶν ἀφρόνων τέκνων νεανίαν ἐνδεῆ φρενῶν,

verses.geez: እመቦ፡ ዘርእየት፡ እምዓብዳን፡ ውሉድ፡ ወሬዛ፡ ነዳየ፡ አእምሮ፡ ዘየሐውር፡ ውስተ፡ ፍናወ፡ ማዕዘንተ፡ ቤታ፡ (ትጼውዖ፡ ወትብሎ)።
verses.translation: and speaking, in the dark of the evening,

translations.lxx: and speaking, in the dark of the evening,
translations.kjv: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,
translations.ron: El trecea pe uliţă pe lângă colţul casei ei şi se îndrepta către locuinţa ei.
translations.grk: παραπορευόμενον παρὰ γωνίαν ἐν διόδοις οἴκων αὐτῆς, καὶ λαλοῦντα

verses.geez: ወይትናገር፡ በጽልመት፡ ሠርከ፡ ሶበ፡ ይከውን፡ ጽማዌ፡ ወጽልመተ፡ ሌሊት።
verses.translation: when there happens to be the stillness of night and of darkness:

translations.lxx: when there happens to be the stillness of night and of darkness:
translations.kjv: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:
translations.ron: Era în amurgul serii unei zile, când se lasă umbra şi întunericul nopţii.
translations.grk: ἐν σκότει ἑσπερινῷ, ἡνίκα ἂν ἡσυχία νυκτερινὴ καὶ γνοφώδης,

verses.geez: ወሶቤሃ፡ ትዳደቆ፡ እንተ፡ ባቲ፡ ትርሢተ፡ ዝሙት፡ እንተ፡ ትሬሲ፡ ታሥርር፡ ልበ፡ ወራዙት።
verses.translation: and the woman meets him having the appearance of a harlot, that causes the hearts of young men to flutter.

translations.lxx: and the woman meets him having the appearance of a harlot, that causes the hearts of young men to flutter.
translations.kjv: And, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.
translations.ron: Şi iată o femeie îl întâmpină, având înfăţişare de desfrânată şi cu prefăcătorie în inimă;
translations.grk: ἡ δὲ γυνὴ συναντᾷ αὐτῷ, εἶδος ἔχουσα πορνικὸν, ἣ ποιεῖ νέων ἐξίπτασθαι καρδίας.

verses.geez: ሥርርት፡ ይእቲ፡ ወምርዕት፡ ወሥርውት፡ ወበቤታኒ፡ ኢያዓርፉ፡ እገሪሃ።
verses.translation: And she is fickle, and debauched, and her feet abide not at home.

translations.lxx: And she is fickle, and debauched, and her feet abide not at home.
translations.kjv: (She is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:
translations.ron: Aprigă şi de neţinut în frâu, picioarele ei nu se mai odihneau în casă;
translations.grk: Ἀνεπτερωμένη δέ ἐστι καὶ ἄσωτος, ἐν οἴκῳ δὲ οὐχ ἡσυχάζουσιν οἱ πόδες αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ወምዕረ፡ ኅዳጠ፡ አፍኣ፡ ታንጎጉ፡ ወምዕረ፡ ኅዳጠ፡ ውስተ፡ መራኅብት፡ ወውስተ፡ ማዕዘንት፡ ትጸንሕ።
verses.translation: For at one time she wanders without, and at another time she lies in wait in the streets, at every corner.

translations.lxx: For at one time she wanders without, and at another time she lies in wait in the streets, at every corner.
translations.kjv: Now is she without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)
translations.ron: Când în casă, când afară, stând la pândă lângă orice colţ.
translations.grk: Χρόνον γάρ τινα ἔξω ῥέμβεται, χρόνον δὲ ἐν πλατείαις παρὰ πᾶσαν γωνίαν ἐνεδρεύει.

verses.geez: ወአኀዘቶ፡ ወሰዓመቶ፡ ወዘእንበለ፡ ኃፍረት፡ በገጽ፡ ትብሎ።
verses.translation: Then she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said to him,

translations.lxx: Then she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said to him,
translations.kjv: So she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,
translations.ron: Ea îl apucă şi-l sărută şi cu o căutătură obraznică îi zise:
translations.grk: Εἶτα ἐπιλαβομένη ἐφίλησεν αὐτὸν, ἀναιδεῖ δὲ προσώπῳ προσεῖπεν αὐτῷ,

verses.geez: መሥዋዕተ፡ ሰላምየ፡ ውእቱ፡ ም፡ ብፅዓትየ፡ እሁብ።
verses.translation: I have a peace-offering; to-day I pay my vows:

translations.lxx: I have a peace-offering; to-day I pay my vows:
translations.kjv: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.
translations.ron: "Trebuia să aduc jertfe de pace; astăzi am împlinit făgăduinţele mele;
translations.grk: θυσία εἰρηνική μοι ἐστὶ, σήμερον ἀποδίδωμι τὰς εὐχάς μου.

verses.geez: በዝንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ መጻእኩ፡ እትቀበልከ፡ ወእንዘ፡ አፈቅር፡ ገጸ፡ ዚአከ፡ ረከብኩከ።
verses.translation: therefore I came forth to meet thee, desiring thy face; and I have found thee.

translations.lxx: therefore I came forth to meet thee, desiring thy face; and I have found thee.
translations.kjv: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.
translations.ron: Pentru aceasta am ieşit în întâmpinarea ta, ca să te caut şi iată că te-am găsit.
translations.grk: Ἕνεκα τούτου ἐξῆλθον εἰς συνάντησίν σοι, ποθοῦσα τὸ σὸν πρόσωπον, εὕρηκά σε.

verses.geez: በቀጠንት፡ ገለድኩ፡ ምስካብየ፡ ወዘርቤታተ፡ ነጸፍኩ፡ ዘእምግብፅ፡ ነስነስኩ፡ ምስካብየ፡ በመጽርይ፡ ወቤትየኒ፡ በቀናንሞስ፡ ነዓ፡ ናስተሐውዝ፡ በተሳዕሞ፡ እስከ፡ ነግህ።
verses.translation: I have spread my bed with sheets, and I have covered it with double tapestry from Egypt.

translations.lxx: I have spread my bed with sheets, and I have covered it with double tapestry from Egypt.
translations.kjv: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt.
translations.ron: Cu scoarţe am gătit patul meu, cu aşternuturi de în din Egipt,
translations.grk: κειρίαις τέτακα τὴν κλίνην μου, ἀμφιτάποις δὲ ἔστρωκα τοῖς ἀπʼ Αἰγύπτου.

verses.geez: ወናንገርግር፡ በተፋቅሮ፡ እስመ፡ ኢሀሎ፡ ምትየ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤቱ።
verses.translation: I have sprinkled my couch with saffron, and my house with cinnamon.

translations.lxx: I have sprinkled my couch with saffron, and my house with cinnamon.
translations.kjv: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
translations.ron: Cu miresme am stropit patul meu, cu mir, aloe şi chinamon.
translations.grk: Διέῤῥαγκα τὴν κοίτην μου κροκίνῳ, τὸν δὲ οἶκόν μου κινναμώμῳ·

verses.geez: ወሖረ፡ ርኁቀ፡ ብሔረ፡ ዕቊረ፡ ወርቅ፡ ነሢኦ፡ ውስተ፡ እዴሁ፡ ወመዋዕል፡ ብዙኅ፡ እመ፡ ገብአ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤቱ።
verses.translation: Come, and let us enjoy love until the morning; come, and let us embrace in love.

translations.lxx: Come, and let us enjoy love until the morning; come, and let us embrace in love.
translations.kjv: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.
translations.ron: Vino, să ne îmbătăm de iubire până dimineaţă, să ne cufundăm în desfătări de dragoste,
translations.grk: Ἐλθὲ καὶ ἀπολαύσωμεν φιλίας ἕως ὄρθρου, δεῦρο καὶ ἐλκυλισθῶμεν ἔρωτι.

verses.geez: ወአስሐተቶ፡ በብዙኅ፡ ነገር፡ ወበመሥገርተ፡ ከናፍሪሃ፡ ሰሐበቶ።
verses.translation: For my husband is not at home, but is gone on a long journey,

translations.lxx: For my husband is not at home, but is gone on a long journey,
translations.kjv: For the goodman is not at home, he is gone a long journey:
translations.ron: Că bărbatul meu nu este acasă, plecat-a la drum departe,
translations.grk: Οὐ γὰρ πάρεστιν ὁ ἀνήρ μου ἐν οἴκω, πεπόρευται δὲ ὁδὸν μακράν,

verses.geez: ወተለዋ፡ ደኒኖ፡ ከመ፡ ላሕም፡ ዘየሐውር፡ ለተጠብሖ፡ ወከመ፡ ከልብ፡ ለተአስሮ።
verses.translation: having taken in his hand a bundle of money: after many days he will return to his house.

translations.lxx: having taken in his hand a bundle of money: after many days he will return to his house.
translations.kjv: He hath taken a bag of money with him, and will come home at the day appointed.
translations.ron: Luat-a cu dânsul o pungă cu bani şi se va întoarce acasă la lună plină!"
translations.grk: ἔνδεσμον ἀργυρίου λαβὼν ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ, διʼ ἡμερῶν πολλῶν ἐπανήξει εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ ኃየል፡ ዘተነድፈ፡ ወተሐይጰ፡ ከብዶ፡ ወይጔጒእ፡ ከመ፡ ዖፍ፡ ለመሥገርት።
verses.translation: So with much converse she prevailed on him to go astray, and with the snares of her lips she forced him from the right path.

translations.lxx: So with much converse she prevailed on him to go astray, and with the snares of her lips she forced him from the right path.
translations.kjv: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.
translations.ron: Ea îl ademeni prin mulţimea cuvintelor ei şi-l smulse prin graiurile ademenitoare ale buzelor sale;
translations.grk: Ἀπεπλάνησε δὲ αὐτὸν πολλῇ ὁμιλίᾳ, βρόχοις τε τοῖς ἀπὸ χειλέων ἐξώκειλεν αὐτόν.

verses.geez: ወኢየአምር፡ ከመ፡ በነፍሱ፡ ይረውፅ።
verses.translation: And he followed her, being gently led on, and that as an ox is led to the slaughter, and as a dog to bonds, or as a hart shot in the liver with an arrow:

translations.lxx: And he followed her, being gently led on, and that as an ox is led to the slaughter, and as a dog to bonds, or as a hart shot in the liver with an arrow:
translations.kjv: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;
translations.ron: El începu să meargă dintr-o dată după ea, ca un bou la junghiere şi ca un cerb care se zoreşte spre capcană,
translations.grk: Ὁ δὲ ἐπηκολούθησεν αὐτῇ κεπφωθείς· ὥσπερ δὲ βοῦς ἐπὶ σφαγὴν ἄγεται, καὶ ὥσπερ κύων ἐπὶ δεσμοὺς,

verses.geez: ወይእዜኒ፡ ስምዐኒ፡ ወልድየ፡ ወአጽምእ፡ ቃለ፡ አፉየ።
verses.translation: and he hastens as a bird into a snare, not knowing that he is running for his life.

translations.lxx: and he hastens as a bird into a snare, not knowing that he is running for his life.
translations.kjv: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it is for his life.
translations.ron: Până când o săgeată îi străpunge ficatul; după cum o pasăre grăbeşte spre laţ şi nu-şi dă seama că acolo îşi sfârşeşte viaţa.
translations.grk: ἢ ὡς ἔλαφος τοξεύματι πεπληγὼς εἰς τὸ ἧπαρ· σπεύδει δὲ ὥσπερ ὄρνεον εἰς παγίδα, οὐκ εἰδὼς ὅτι περὶ ψυχῆς τρέχει.

verses.geez: ወኢይትመየጥ፡ ለወብከ፡ ውስተ፡ ፍናዊሃ፡ ወኢትስሐት፡ ውስተ፡ አሠራ።
verses.translation: Now then, my son, hearken to me, and attend to the words of my mouth.

translations.lxx: Now then, my son, hearken to me, and attend to the words of my mouth.
translations.kjv: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.
translations.ron: Şi acum, fiule, ascultă-mă şi ia aminte la cuvintele gurii mele!
translations.grk: Νῦν οὖν υἱὲ ἄκουέ μου, καὶ πρόσεχε ῥήμασι στόματός μου.

verses.geez: ወብዙኃነ፡ አስሒታ፡ አቊሰለት፡ ወአልቦሙ፡ ኊልቊ፡ ለእለ፡ አስሐተቶሙ።
verses.translation: Let not thine heart turn aside to her ways:

translations.lxx: Let not thine heart turn aside to her ways:
translations.kjv: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.
translations.ron: Inima ta să nu se plece spre căile ei şi nu te rătăci pe potecile ei,
translations.grk: Μὴ ἐκκλινάτω εἰς τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῆς ἡ καρδία σου,

verses.geez: ፍናወ፡ ሲኦል፡ ቤታ፡ እለ፡ ያወርዱ፡ ውስተ፡ መዛግብቲሁ፡ ለሞት።
verses.translation: for she has wounded and cast down many, and those whom she has slain are innumerable.

translations.lxx: for she has wounded and cast down many, and those whom she has slain are innumerable.
translations.kjv: For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been slain by her.
translations.ron: Căci ea a rănit pe mulţi şi pe foarte mulţi i-a omorât.
translations.grk: πολλοὺς γὰρ τρώσασα καταβέβληκε, καὶ ἀναρίθμητοί εἰσιν οὓς πεφόνευκεν.
